version_note: v229 was taken by the parallel Attention line (attention-amc1-k-mean-recenter) while this was in flight; v230 is a sibling of v229, both parented on the same root 56dc805d
mechanism: L-EM1's exact-metric mantissa code descent, re-scheduled group-major: step k moves group k of every 64-block at once, so a pass costs 16 sequential iterations instead of 640/1024
build: append-only: parent bytes + fixed separator + implementation module; every parent byte, the Attention four APIs and all shared helpers are byte-identical

fixed_choices.target: ideal J(X) = ||(X - T) W_hat^T||^2 with T = X_ref C G^{-1}; L - J is independent of X
fixed_choices.metric: G = h_inv^{-1} - c I rebuilt from the parent state
fixed_choices.ridge: c = mean(diag(inverse)) - mean(diag(W_hat^T W_hat)); the two means are taken in different hooks, never the fused matrix
fixed_choices.candidate_set: one element of one natural 4-element group, mantissa code +-1 at fixed scale_factor/lv2/lv3
fixed_choices.accept_rule: exact quadratic over the whole per-row move; a rejected row does not move in that step

passes_note: the plan card pre-registered K=2 with a time-driven fallback; the backoff rule fired under both paired measurement runs, so K=1 -- see time_projection
accurate_only_upgrade: the calibration hook's Cholesky inverse was eliminated without changing memory: c is no longer materialised there. mean(diag(gram)) is stored at calibration and mean(diag(h_inv^-1)) is taken at dynamic time, where the inverse is built anyway. Mathematically identical; verify.py control C measures diag_gap=0 and path_rel=0 bit-for-bit.

local_result.protocol: proxy-v3, Qwen3.5-4B proxy-v2, linear-only, six shards
local_result.zero_case_note: the 48 zeros are exactly the out-of-scope proj role (6 shards x 8 cases), bit-identical to the parent

time_projection.dynamic_api: same-process paired, arms alternated with cuda.synchronize inside the timed region, 8 repeats, 9 cases
time_projection.k2_projection: 297.5s, i.e. above the pre-registered 296s line; that is why K=1
time_projection.cross_process_check: over the 336 six-shard cases the cross-process scoring delta is +0.0376 s/call against a paired prediction of +0.0400, a 6% agreement that reproduces the paired measurement independently
time_projection.risk_note: official time is the only gate and the recorded precedent is that it is not predictable from local marginals; v222 measured officially at 293s for a +12s marginal, which is the closest anchor to this candidate's +12.5s, while v229 timed out on a near-zero-cost mechanism.
time_projection.conversion_bracket: two conventions bracket the projection. Naive additive (the plan card's): 281 + 6.5 + 6.0 = 294 s, margin ~6 s. The project's own fitted decomposition (docs/official-local-fitting-analysis-2026-09-04.md section 4, 21 versions, R^2=0.799), applied differentially to the two APIs this card changes: 0.7344*6.5 (dynamic activation) + 0.1154*6.0 (weight calibration) = +5.5 s, i.e. 286.5 s, margin ~13.5 s -- the official Kunpeng 920B is cheap for large matrices and expensive for small tensors. The regression is known to underestimate newer versions by ~20 s and its negative dyn_qkv coefficient is a collinearity artifact, so the fitted figure is an estimate, not a measurement. Both brackets sit inside the gate but the margins differ by 2x; this archive claims neither as comfortable.
time_projection.k2_retrospective: under the fitted conversion K=2 would project to 289 s and would not have tripped the 296 s fallback; under the naive convention it projected 297.5 s and did. K=1 is a conclusion of the plan card's convention, recorded as such rather than presented as forced by the physics. K was not re-selected after the fact.

verification.controls: A append-only + isolated import, B parent-off bit identity + out-of-scope bypass at in=4160, C H/gram_diag_mean/G recovery + the real _em1_metric code path, D monotonicity + predicted-cost identity + gradient finite difference, E determinism + state round-trip, F schedule shape

local_decision_note: the tool's local_trend_gate is `delta_mean > 0 and L1 < 0.02`, an eligibility screen for small local trends; the tool's own policy states 'local eligibility is not promotion'. A mechanism that deliberately makes a large change exceeds that L1 by design. The signal that matters here is 288 positive / 0 negative / 48 zero out of 336.
